title: Research: exclude the P112 support-72 mixed-edge profile
body:
## Summary

Exclude the actual twelve-piece P112 TWOSIDE `(b,t)=(8,4)` profile `4,5^2,6^9` over every characteristic-zero field, under the stated piece/code-intersection hypotheses.

```text
Support-72 edges, beyond the old root-only cutoff
  120 root + 128 eligible D7-normal directions
  one normalized non-root edge, 58 further vertices
  10,520 seven-cliques, 608 of rank eight
  required endpoint support >=182 > allowance 180

All-root branch: required support >=204
```

Adds only `research/p112-mixed-edge-simplex/`, with the complete proof, exact source pins, finite receipt, positive witness, separate finite checker and registered reproduction. This removes one profile, not the entire cell or C5. No decoder-floor, supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 for the reduction and handoff; Nick Petalas/PR3164 and PR3175 for retained geometry, root-simplex proofs and the preceding support-spectrum method. Main baseline is `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. Frozen inputs remain unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: the profile's pair supports can reach 72, so the predecessor's below-70 root-edge premise fails. Its weight-only two-six-flat cover needs 20 cuts and has no rank-four nonbasis anchor.
- After: the enlarged alphabet is complete by the written Weyl-chamber argument and exact closure/support checks. Minor-based and Gram-based intersection algorithms, separate clique enumerators and separate exact rank implementations reproduce the full support histogram.
- Fifteen behavioral groups pass, including a substantive one-extra-cut control: the retained witness falls from 182 to 179 at 33 cuts.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and optimized Python 3.13 read-only Git-free committed export pass. Strict Ruff diagnostics pass. All 18 publication files/inputs byte-match commit `1111a074414c4d2be8b4e230133d873432780814`.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-mixed-edge-simplex
```

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-18999969). `CHECKS.json` records environments, commands and limits. Evidence is author-checked, not independent human or proof-kernel review. The standard Weyl-chamber theorem and original reduction remain explicit dependencies. Development and local checks used substantial automated assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

An isolated package with bounded opt-in replay. No shared verifier, selected record, supplier or frozen archive changes.
